name: monte02_left
description: Monte02's left arm on its wheeled body, replaying the left hand of BOX recordings (docs/monte02_left_arm_roadmap.html, M1.5). The gripper is the BOX's, moved over with its BOX (D2): its opening, force and touch come from the BOX, not from the robot. The chassis drives between sessions and is registered when it docks (session_edge, H2: a marker rig on the body, measured after the brakes are on); that registration does not exist yet, so absolute replay is refused. The waist, the head and the right arm are set once per session and held (session_locked_joints); their values are the session's, chosen by M2.2' within the T2 anti-tip whitelist -- the wheels and the body never move together. Datasets stay in the camera world they were recorded in. Not in service: no replay_config until the Monte02Arm adapter (M3.2); the URDF is the vendor's theory v1 with our GMSL2 camera, to be replaced by the one the robot's host publishes.
